events.title: Product-surface model attribution clarified
events.summary: Controlled product runs may disclose provider-managed auxiliary models. The selected model must appear in returned usage, every auxiliary is recorded, and the result cannot be described as isolated-model evidence.

events.title: Fable 5 Claude Code reproduction accepted for three probes
events.summary: Three isolated Claude Code CLI trials with Fable 5 selected passed revalidation, state reconciliation and historical validity. Haiku 4.5 auxiliary use is disclosed; the findings apply to the tested product surface and are not an isolated-model claim.

events.title: Behavioral-test readiness labels corrected
events.summary: Models whose per-probe eligibility still requires review are no longer labeled TEST REQUIRED. They remain outside the test queue until a behavioral scope and method are reviewed. No probe was run and no observation verdict changed.

events.title: Initial evidence-candidate batch invalidated
events.summary: The first live public-issue search produced 45 candidates using overly broad lexical and identity matching. The entire batch was invalidated as pipeline output and the screening policy was tightened. This does not judge each source and did not change any observation or verdict.

events.title: Public evidence watch introduced
events.summary: The Monitor can now search official pages, public issue reports, research indexes and an optional broad-web channel for leads related to the five probes. Matches remain review candidates and never become automatic behavioral verdicts.

events.title: Five OpenAI model records reviewed
events.summary: Official-source metadata changes for Daybreak Red, Daybreak Blue, gpt-oss-120b, gpt-oss-20b and GPT-3.5 were accepted after human review. No behavioral verdict was inferred.

events.title: GPT-6 Astra added to the model catalog
events.summary: An official OpenAI source established this public model identity. Discovery records identity only; it does not imply that any probe passed or failed.

events.title: Codex Luna temporal-anchor observation added
events.summary: A human-reviewed controlled observation was added for the Codex desktop surface. Its scope does not extend to the OpenAI API or other products.

events.title: Official model discovery began
events.summary: The Monitor began checking approved official provider sources daily. A source check alone does not create a behavioral verdict or a public data change.
